name: frontend-powers
description: Opinionated engineering skills for AI-assisted frontend development: client-rendered Vite SPAs in TypeScript and React with TanStack Router and Query, orval, Tailwind and Base UI, Biome, Vitest, Playwright, and pnpm.

interface.longDescription: Frontend Powers gives Codex an opinionated playbook for client-rendered Vite SPAs in TypeScript and React - project structure, TanStack Router and Query, orval-generated API clients, TanStack Form, Tailwind and Base UI, Vitest, MSW and Playwright testing, Biome and pnpm tooling, Keycloak auth, i18n, realtime, static deploy with a strict CSP, and shared packages - plus scaffolding a brand-new app from a buildable template.
defaultPrompt: Scaffold a brand-new Vite + React SPA from scratch.
Use Frontend Powers for this frontend change.
Review this SPA against Frontend Powers.
